links.comparator_used: FARUSS-based screening without image quality-based triage (all images analyzed regardless of quality)
links.outcome: Missed FNAB recommendations in FARUSS-based screening
links.effect: Image quality-based triage mitigated missed FNAB recommendations in an exploratory simulation. Without triage, 19.2% of FNAB recommendations were missed. The abstract does not give the post-triage rate.
links.tradeoff: The result comes from an exploratory simulation only. The abstract does not quantify the extra on-site examinations that triage would add.
links.quote: Image quality-based triage mitigated missed FNAB recommendations in exploratory simulation.

links.comparator_used: Sonologist revision of AI-assisted ACR TI-RADS assessment versus unrevised AI-assisted assessment, with conventional US-based ACR TI-RADS assessment as the reference
links.outcome: Agreement with conventional US-based ACR TI-RADS assessment
links.quote: Aitrox-USIP reduced analysis time (183 s vs. 254 s; p < 0.001), and sonologist revision improved agreement with conventional US-based ACR TI-RADS assessment ( κ , 0.754–0.879).
